2116937238722625816.en_summary: UBS models $META Muse at 3M daily users, requiring ~3,000 $AMD EPYC chips in base case (750K agents with 4x CPU sharing) or ~23,800 without sharing. At 100M users, nearly 100,000 chips plus 8GB RAM and 100GB SSD per agent, pushing DRAM toward 2TB per host, creating opportunity for $MU and $SNDK.
2116937238722625816.zh_summary: UBS模型顯示$META Muse僅有300萬每日用戶，基本情況下需要約3000顆$AMD EPYC晶片（75萬代理同時運行且4倍CPU共享），或無共享時約23800顆。若達1億用戶，幾乎需要10萬顆晶片，加上每代理8GB RAM和100GB SSD，DRAM需求可能達每主機2TB，為$MU和$SNDK帶來機會。

2116930768136245591.en_summary: The largest US physical-gold backed ETF $GLD recorded -$1.8 billion outflows in October, biggest monthly since June and 3rd-largest since Feb 2024. YTD -$3.8 billion, on track for first annual outflow since 2023, versus +$23.0 billion in 2025. Investors withdrew -$1.5 billion from gold and precious metal funds last week, 2nd weekly outflow in 7 weeks. Gold flows highly volatile.
2116930768136245591.zh_summary: 美國最大實體黃金支持ETF $GLD在10月錄得-18億美元流出，為6月以來最大月度撤資，也是2024年2月以來第三大。年初至今-38億美元，有望成為2023年以來首次年度流出，相比2025年+230億美元。投資者上週從黃金及其他貴金屬基金撤出-15億美元，為過去7週第二次週流出。黃金資金流目前高度波動。

2116928239562338616.en_summary: 2027 shaping up as biggest step change in AI power density: $NVDA Rubin Ultra ~500kW per rack, $AMD MI500 ~1,000kW, $AMZN Trainium4 ~330kW, $GOOGL TPU v9 ~200kW. Traditional data centers built for ~10kW CPU racks will need major upgrades and different electrical and liquid cooling systems.
2116928239562338616.zh_summary: 2027年將成為AI功率密度最大步進變化：$NVDA Rubin Ultra每機架約500kW，$AMD MI500約1000kW，$AMZN Trainium4約330kW，$GOOGL TPU v9約200kW。傳統資料中心為約10kW CPU機架建造，需要大量升級現有設施，並在新建中採用不同的電力與液冷系統。
